annotations.text: Onboarding — Welcome and Login serve M1 (join code, C5) and M2 (accounts), designed now so M0 chrome fits them later. No login on site: the foreman joins with a code, once.
Home + capture flow — the 30-second path: today card, record, photos, done. Home supersedes the old bare capture screen (Main folded into Home). One primary action per screen; no typing on site.
Sync visibility (B2/B3, hardened in C1). The count is first-class UI; offline is a calm dark card, not an error. Nothing is deleted locally before server confirmation.
Server pipeline states (B4/B5). Confirmation is the mandatory gate before the report is sent; corrections here are the training signal. Needs-review shows raw evidence, never loses data.
